subx.verdict: no target switches to configuration B; everything ships on A
subx.coverage_note:
Cached SubX is the CFSv2 forecast series only, 2018-01 to 2025-12, 96 months each of pr and tas. The hindcast series (1999 to 2017-09-30) was not ingested, so configuration B can see no row before 2018. The restored split trains on 2007 to 2021 and validates on 2022 to 2023, so the whole validation period lies inside SubX coverage and both arms score the same rows, while B's own fit draws only on the 2018 to 2021 part of the training split. Ensemble size and configuration differ between the hindcast and forecast series, which is why subx_is_forecast travels with the data.

Superseded note, kept because earlier artifacts quote it:
SubX CFSv2 has no hindcast coverage inside the training split: the hindcast series ends 2017-09-30 and the training split begins 2018, so configuration B draws only on the forecast series. With a 2018 to 2020 training split and one year held out, B is trained on at most 2 years per fold, and on at most 7 years were the split extended to 2025. Ensemble size and configuration differ between the hindcast and forecast series, which is why subx_is_forecast travels with the data.
